chunks: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Hishām ibn Sālim and more than one person, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:

He was asked about a woman against whom a man used excessive force, and he claimed that she died from his violence against her. He عليه السلام said: "The full blood money must be paid, and the man is not to be executed."

key_terms.كَامِلَةً: in full; indicating that the complete amount is due
key_terms.لَا يُقْتَلُ ٱلرَّجُلُ: the man is not executed; qisas is not applied here
key_terms.ٱلدِّيَةُ: blood money; the financial compensation owed for causing death

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman dies after a man used violent force against her?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who dies after a man used excessive force against her. The Imam عليه السلام rules that the full diyyah is due, while qisas by execution is not carried out against the man in this case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5215 - Ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Hisham ibn Salim and others from Abu Abdullah (as) that that Imam (as) was asked about a woman upon whom a man used excessive force, and he claimed that she died due to his violence against her.
Imam (as) said: "The full blood money (diyyah) must be paid, but the man is not to be executed."
